title: Story premise EDU056: The Reversible Door
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (work/process). Hook: Which door lets us walk back out? Takeaway/theme: Decision process should reflect consequences, reversibility, and actual authority.
description: A product team wants to test two layouts, but treats a replaceable mockup as if it were a permanent public launch. Marking reversibility and consequence lets them try the mockup while reserving review for the lasting decision.
